custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use an active tracked part, part A, that was at the test location before this release was installed and that no other test needs.
  • Use a date before the release, date A, on which the Inventory Value report lists part A.
  • Write down part A's Qty and Total Cost on the Inventory Value report for date A.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

Setup

  1. Find parts from before this release: On the Inventory list, parts that came with this site's data and were never changed have no clock icon at the left of their row; for example 3030 Long Stroke Brake Chamber (W3030LS), which has stock and Min 10 and Max 50, and 3030 Standard Brake Chamber, 13.25" Rod (W3030T). Use W3030T as part A.
  2. Click Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value under PARTS; click the As of: date and pick a date before this release.
  3. On that report click Search, type W3030T and note its Qty and Total Cost.
